All owned resources and private keys were removed with cleanup complete.

newQualificationToolingDelta.behavior: Explicitly import inbox Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility by PSHOME path so Get-FileHash remains available when module auto-loading is disabled.
newQualificationToolingDelta.evidence: Current supporting Windows tooling passes all391 tests. The regression executes a PowerShell probe with module auto-loading disabled and real Get-FileHash while network/download edges are stubbed.
newQualificationToolingDelta.limitation: Tooling self-test; not a new native CA campaign.

exclusions: This mapping does not automatically qualify rebuilt Go/native binaries. Any new compiler/runtime build must be covered by its separate artifact provenance/security and focused binary acceptance receipts.
Prior 169 distinct native scenario passes remain preserved on their historical sources and environment; this mapping does not relabel them as a stock nine-environment collector pass.
Focused hosted execution used disposable self-signed certificates and a public SAN-only certificate in owned IIS/store resources; no domain/CA lab or new AD CS campaign was started.
